details.description: GLM-4.7-Flash is Z.ai's (formerly Zhipu AI) lightweight, open-weight chat model in the GLM-4.7 series, released January 19, 2026. It uses a 30-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 3 billion active parameters per token, and it is designed for resource-constrained deployment while still supporting agentic reasoning, coding, and multi-turn tool use. It is a text-only model that supports Preserved Thinking mode for multi-turn agentic tasks, per its Hugging Face model card; as of September 2026 it has itself been superseded by GLM-5.3-Flash, Z.ai's newer lightweight model.
advantages: Scores 59.2% on SWE-bench Verified, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 91.6 on AIME 2025 and 75.2 on GPQA, per its Hugging Face model card.
Runs with only 3 billion active parameters per token (30B total, Mixture-of-Experts), making it deployable on consumer hardware, per its Hugging Face model card.
Released under the MIT license with open weights, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Scores lower than the full GLM-4.7 on coding benchmarks, e.g. 59.2% vs 73.8% on SWE-bench Verified, per both models' Hugging Face cards.
Text-only model; does not accept image or other non-text input, per Z.ai's API documentation.
Superseded as Z.ai's lightweight model by GLM-5.3-Flash (released August 26, 2026), per Z.ai's release-notes page, though GLM-4.7-Flash remains offered on the free tier.
use_cases: Lightweight or local deployment of an agentic coding assistant on consumer hardware
Multi-turn tool use and agentic reasoning
Coding tasks and software-engineering task completion

sources.title: New Released - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens (4000) is far below the 131,072-token default max output listed on GLM-4.7-Flash's Hugging Face card; likely a Bedrock-specific output cap, kept the catalog's value per instructions. GLM-4.7-Flash has itself been superseded as Z.ai's lightweight flagship by GLM-5.3-Flash (released August 26, 2026), per docs.z.ai's release-notes page, though it remains listed as an active, free-tier model on docs.z.ai's pricing page. No explicit language list found on maker pages beyond 'en'/'zh' metadata tags, so languages is left empty.
